identity.title: Coordinate display-store and viewer image lifetime

origin.summary: The 2026-08-23 4512 owner/copy census proved that display-store replacement or removal cannot safely dispose the prior Bitmap while central, docked, or popout presenters may still borrow it. Independent clone removal would create a use-after-dispose window.

state.current_summary: Display-store replacement, removal, reload, popout close, and shell disposal now share one lease/refcount retirement boundary. The final current-source five-cycle exact 4512 gate, direct lease retirement contract, focused regressions, solution build, readiness, dependency, sample, documentation, and diff gates pass without stale pixels, disposed access, Preview/Run or route side effects, or non-plateauing resources.

objective.summary: Give display-store Bitmaps and every long-lived viewer consumer one coordinated lifetime boundary so replaced or removed images are reclaimed only after all borrowers have rebound or released them.
constraints: Do not immediately dispose a replaced store Bitmap while any Canvas, zoom controller, docked viewer, or popout viewer can still reference it.
Do not remove a full-size clone unless the new owner contract proves equal image identity and no stale borrower.
Preserve explicit Preview/Run, layer create/delete/select, active-layer, command CanExecute, and Pipeline routing contracts.
Keep implementation and evidence in C:\Git\OpenVisionLab_Dev; original-repository promotion remains separately authorized.

criteria.text: A source owner/borrower census names the display-store owner, every central/docked/popout borrower, the rebind/release point, and the single retirement point for replacement, deletion, reload, popout close, and shell disposal.

Repeated exact 4512 replace, delete, reload, dock, popout, close, and forced-GC cycles complete without ObjectDisposedException, stale pixels, leaked prior images, or non-plateauing process/handle/GDI/USER resources.

The exact Main store hash, workspace and automatic-dock 4512 dimensions/texture creation, image-load quick actions, no-auto-Preview/Run behavior, active layer, and Pipeline routes remain unchanged after the lifetime correction.

Before/after copy and process-resource evidence demonstrates that every removed clone or hidden allocation is actually gone, while the strengthened 4512 catastrophe ceilings still pass; unmeasured GPU and intra-SetMain peaks remain explicitly bounded rather than overclaimed.

context.location: ImageSpaceFrame Borrow/TakeOwnership and synchronous DisplayManager frame consumption are complete.
Final-code exact 4512 runs retain 523.0/524.2 MB private growth and observe 526.1/524.2 MB maximum private growth under the current three-snapshot gate.

evidence.observation: The owner/borrower census identifies ImageSpaceService/ImageSpaceImage as the store owner, the central workspace lease, docked and popout clone borrowers, each rebind/release point, and the single reference-count-zero retirement point for replacement, deletion, reload, close, and shell disposal.

Five exact 4512 replace/dock/popout/close-delete/GC/reload cycles passed. Every store, docked, and popout replacement hash matched; live Layer Viewer count stayed at the baseline; private, working-set, managed, handle, GDI, and USER retained ranges were 15.0 MB, 5.4 MB, 0.1 MB, 24, 0, and 0.

The existing 4512 reliability, workspace image load and quick actions, layer management and popout, large-image, owned-Mat load, and OpenGL template-editor targets all passed in one process after the lifetime correction.

Before explicit SharpGL timer shutdown, retained USER objects rose 50,54,58,62,66,70 with range 16 and the gate failed. After shutdown, all five retained USER samples stayed at 50 with range 0 while exact hashes and viewer behavior remained unchanged.
HistoryContract=OK, including replaced and removed ImageSpace images remaining readable through an active lease and being disposed only when the last lease releases.

The Debug Any CPU solution build passed with zero warnings and errors; readiness 13/13, vendored dependency, and public sample asset contracts passed with 33 catalog rows, 229 assets, and 17 Pipelines.

The final current-source five-cycle exact 4512 gate passed after the central rebind exception-path correction. Every replacement hash matched; live viewer count stayed one; private, working-set, managed, handle-range, positive-handle-growth, GDI, and USER values were 16.8 MB, 4.3 MB, 0.1 MB, 21, 2, 0, and 0; total elapsed was 70.311 seconds.

The final current-source existing 4512 reliability, workspace image load and quick actions, layer management and popout, large-image, owned-Mat load, and OpenGL template-editor targets passed in one process; HistoryContractCheck also passed.

events.summary: PL-0004 resolved: the coordinated display-store/viewer retirement boundary and all four acceptance criteria passed in Dev; GPU VRAM, intra-operation peaks, OpenGL exception coverage, and actual-EXE qualification remain separate work.
